subject: Renewal accelerator & stair-step capacity plan — kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Anna Park <anna@greenbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal accelerator & stair-step capacity plan — kickoff

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the productive QBR last month. As we discussed, GreenByte's usage has been growing faster than the committed baseline and we want to align on a renewal structure that gives you predictable unit economics while unlocking headroom for the next 12–18 months.

Proposed kickoff objectives:
- Confirm renewal window and preferred term (12 vs 24 vs 36 months)
- Review stair-step capacity proposal (+30% initial reserve, optional quarterly uplifts)
- Align procurement owner and timeline for PO/SOW
- Book QBR and technical readiness meeting (capacity handoff)

Suggested timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): Renewal kickoff & mutual action plan draft
- Week 1: Pricing & term agreement; procurement handoff
- Week 2–3: Final SOW & PO; QBR scheduling

Who I recommend on our side: Marissa (Customer Success) to drive the QBR/deck, Markus (Solutions/LA) to validate capacity and latency SLOs, Jordan (Sales Ops) to coordinate terms & procurement.

Anna — could you share preferred renewal term and 2–3 windows for a 60-minute kickoff in the next two weeks? I attached a starter SOW and a capacity worksheet for your review.

Attachments: GRT_Renewal_SOW_v1.pdf, greenbyte_capacity_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Anna Park <anna@greenbyte.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenByte Procurement <procurement@greenbyte.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal accelerator & stair-step capacity plan — kickoff

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear outline. GreenByte is definitely interested in a stair-step model; our initial preference would be an 18–24 month term with an immediate 25–30% buffer as you suggested. Procurement will need a line-item SOW and an estimate broken down by committed vs burst usage for the PO.

I can do a kickoff on Monday 6/4 between 10–12 PT or Wednesday 6/6 after 1pm PT. If you have a short one-page mutual action plan (MAP) we can sign off quickly, that would speed things up on our side.

CCing our procurement lead (procurement@greenbyte.com) for visibility.

—Anna
Anna Park
Head of Platform Engineering, GreenByte
anna@greenbyte.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: GreenByte renewal kickoff prep

Team —

Quick internal note to assign owners before the external kickoff:
- Marissa: Lead QBR + 1-pager MAP. Use the attached SOW + the GreenByte usage sheet to build a 6-slide QBR.
- Markus: Validate the stair-step capacity numbers in the spreadsheet and confirm any hardware/latency caveats for burst usage.
- Jordan: Prepare a draft commercial term (18 vs 24 months) with discounts for committed uplift and an estimated PO timeline.

Please have first drafts in the shared drive by EOD Friday so I can circulate to Anna and procurement. I’ll schedule the external kickoff once we confirm availability.

Thanks — Jonas

- Jonas: Consolidate materials and run a 30m prep 6/3 11:00am PT (optional for procurement)
